name: March of Dawn
detailed_description:
Set in a nation on the verge of civil war, March of Dawn is a narrative-driven fantasy JRPG where your choices shape the faith of the land and the people who call it home. Follow the intertwined journeys of two close friends as they walk different paths through a fractured country—each trying to find where they belong in a world that’s falling apart.

Forge your party from a cast of unique allies, build meaningful relationships, and influence the course of a branching story through impactful decisions. Who you stand beside—and why—can change everything.

Combat blends classic turn-based strategy with a wide range of offensive and defensive tools. Adapt your tactics with powerful skills, combination attacks, and defensive abilities to stay one step ahead of the enemy.

Core Features:

  • Dual Perspective Narrative – Experience a rich, character-driven story from the viewpoints of two friends on different sides of a growing conflict.

  • Choice-Driven Storytelling – Your decisions affect character relationships, faction outcomes, and the shape of the journey ahead.

  • Party Building & Customization – Recruit diverse allies with their own stories, skills, and dynamics. Customize your team’s skills and define their combat roles.

  • Relationship System – Deepen bonds between characters both in and out of battle, unlocking new dialogue, combat bonuses, and narrative paths.

  • Themes of Growth & Identity – Discover what it means to find your place in a divided world—where loyalty, belief, and personal purpose are constantly tested.

March of Dawn is a story about people—about growing up, standing for something, and searching for your dawn amidst the shadows of war.

short_description: A fantasy JRPG with fast-paced turn-based combat, a choice-driven narrative, and a dual-perspective story. Customize and grow your party, make impactful decisions, & form relationships. Strengthen your cause as you race to unite the land and it's people.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd Gen) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: ~2 GB GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4th Gen) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD R7 260X or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: ~2 GB MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel Iris or better)
  • Storage: ~2 GB MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Tested on MacBook Pro models from 2015 onward
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 chip or newer Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Apple GPU or discrete AMD graphics
  • Storage: ~2 GB MB available space
